subject: Next step: Private-host architecture review & ops deep-dive
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Rao <aisha.rao@crestwellhealth.com>, Tom Gilbert <tom.gilbert@crestwellhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next step: Private-host architecture review & ops deep-dive

Hi Aisha / Tom —

Great to connect this morning. Quick recap from our discovery: Crestwell wants a private-hosted inference deployment (VPC/on-prem options) to run PHI workloads with predictable latency and clear audit controls. Primary goals you called out:
- HIPAA-compliant data flow and auditability
- Key management (customer-managed KMS/HSM) and no-persistent logging of PHI
- Predictable SLOs for batch and online inference (50–200 RPS target)
- Clear ops handoff and runbook for day-2 maintenance

To keep momentum, let’s schedule the architecture + ops deep-dive (technical call with infra/security). Proposed 60–75 min slots (PT):
- Tue May 23, 9:30–10:45 AM PT
- Wed May 24, 1:00–2:15 PM PT

Agenda (draft):
1) 10–15m quick recap + success criteria
2) 30m topology walk-through (network, KMS, data flow, isolation)
3) 15m ops/runbook & SLAs (deploy, autoscale, fallbacks)
4) 10m Q&A & next steps

Attendees we suggest:
- From Crestwell: security lead, infra lead, one product owner
- From Redwood: me (Sales), Marissa (Solutions Engineering), Connor (Platform/Infra)

I attached a high-level topology and a short ops pre-read to help the call move fast. Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will join? Also flag any compliance artifacts you want us to include (SOC2, BAA, HSM spec).

Thanks — happy to adapt times for UK/Eastern participants if needed.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0182
[Attachment: crestwell-priv-arch-diagram-v1.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: crestwell-ops-pre-read.docx (DOCX)]

From: Aisha Rao <aisha.rao@crestwellhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Gilbert <tom.gilbert@crestwellhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next step: Private-host architecture review & ops deep-dive

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear recap.

We’re aligned on goals. Wed May 24, 1:00–2:15 PM PT works best for our group. I’ll join along with Tom (infrastructure) and I’m trying to get our security lead (Nina Patel) on the call — she may join for the first 30 minutes.

Two quick asks before we lock the calendar:
- Please include any documentation on customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations and whether Redwood supports HSM-backed keys or BYOK flow.
- We’ll need a short network requirements matrix (CIDR ranges, ports, egress rules) and a sense of whether a VPN or VPC peering model is preferred for the private control plane.

Once we confirm the final attendee list I’ll send a calendar invite from our side.

On quoting your note:
> Attendees we suggest: - From Crestwell: security lead, infra lead, one product owner - From Redwood: me (Sales), Marissa (Solutions Engineering), Connor (Platform/Infra)

Looks good — Tom and I will confirm Nina and a product owner by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Aisha Rao
Director of Infrastructure | Crestwell Health
aisha.rao@crestwellhealth.com | +1 206-555-0124

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Rao <aisha.rao@crestwellhealth.com>, Tom Gilbert <tom.gilbert@crestwellhealth.com>

Perfect — locking Wed May 24, 1:00–2:15 PM PT. I created a provisional Zoom and attached an updated diagram that calls out KMS integration options. Meeting link + agenda below. Calendar invite to follow from me; please accept and add any additional attendees.

Zoom: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81234567890?pwd=archreview
Passcode: CW-Arch24

Agenda (final):
- 1:00–1:10 PM PT: Goals & success criteria (Aisha + Ben)
- 1:10–1:40 PM PT: Topology walkthrough (Marissa + Connor) — VPC vs VPN, egress, audit logging
- 1:40–1:55 PM PT: Ops/runbook & day-2 tasks (Connor)
- 1:55–2:15 PM PT: Security questions & next steps (open)

Attachments included here: updated-crestwell-priv-arch-diagram-v2.pdf, ops-pre-read-v1.pdf, prelim-network-requirements.xlsx

Pre-call asks for your security/infrastructure leads:
- Any existing KMS/HSM vendor docs for BYOK
- List of IP ranges you can peer with (if known)
- Any mandatory control frameworks (e.g., specific encryption-at-rest or audit retention beyond SOC2)

Marissa / Connor — can you confirm you’re able to present the topology and have a short list of runbook steps (deploy, failover, patching, token rotation) ready? I’ll draft the calendar invite and include the three attachments.

Thanks all — looking forward to it.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Prep for Crestwell arch review (Wed 1pm PT)

Marissa / Connor — quick internal checklist before today’s call (I already shared the invite to Aisha/Tom/Nina):
- Marissa: please prepare the topology slides — include control-plane isolation options and the preferred kernel/quantization profile we’d recommend for 50–200 RPS.
- Connor: have the ops runbook bullets ready (deploy steps, autoscale thresholds, KV cache considerations, token rotation cadence). Also be prepared to discuss network options: VPC peering vs VPN vs private link and specifics about required routes/egress.
- Attach the three artifacts to the calendar invite (I uploaded v2 of the diagram and the network sheet).
- Bring notes on KMS/HSM flows we support (BYOK, HSM-backed KMS compatibility) and where we need a partnered HSM vendor.

I’ll own intro and next-steps. Let me know if you want me to loop in an extra infra engineer.

Cheers,
Ben
